column1: Labour in terms of Part IV of the Employees’
“group of companies” means a holding company and
“holding company” means a company which as at the
Thirty First day of March 2021, owns more than
fifty per centum of the shares with voting rights
of another company, directly or indirectly, other
than  a  holding  company  incorporated  outside
Sri Lanka and not registered under Chapter XVIII
of the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007;
“partnership” shall have the same meaning assigned
to such expression under the Inland Revenue Act,
“tax return” shall have the same meaning assigned to
